Ru.bar_b_note: B's saturated blue body with orange-tipped spines has Palworld-class appeal, but A's washed-out pale material and grey faint-end body, plus the bare grey stage with no sky, fog or time-of-day grade, keep it short of the same finish.

Ya.bar_b_note: A clean, grounded teal newt-like creature, but its low, flat silhouette barely clears the trainer and its mid-tone teal on grey lacks the value punch of a Palworld creature.

Th.bar_b_note: Same low teal creature as Ya; it is grounded and clean, but its silhouette is low and its value range narrow, so it does not stand out the way Palworld's hero creatures do.

Pv.bar_b_note: The brown-fur storm bear with violet arcs matches the owner's Stormursa bar and has a big, readable silhouette well above the trainer; what holds it back is the empty stage, not the creature.

Uv.bar_b_note: The bird reads as near-white chrome with hard bright feather edges instead of the blue-grey and tan Galecrest palette, so it looks like an untextured placeholder next to Palworld.

Ow.bar_b_note: Murky, dark frames with no purple storm sky or lightning grade, a HUD covering roughly 40% of each frame and flat magenta ground-shape telegraphs sink it next to Palworld's bright, readable boss fight.

Ot.bar_b_note: The woolly ram reads as Stormcapra in standing and hit react, but its faint poses (B especially, a legless white wool blob with splayed horn loops) and the empty stage keep it below a shipping finish.

Ai.bar_b_note: The standing storm wolf matches the Tanglevolt bar, but in faint mid and faint end the body flips to a blown-out white and black blob and the arcs read soft.

Eg.bar_b_note: An appealing teal otter mount with a readable ridden pose at the right scale, but its flat single-hue fur with little rim separation reads a notch under Palworld's mount finish.

Fi.bar_b_note: A warm, expressive elder villager in an olive vest and green scarf that fits the key art's cozy village palette and matches Palworld's NPC finish.

top_changes.change: Ow: shrink and translucent-ise the combat HUD so it clears the fighters, replace flat magenta ground shapes with real lightning/stone telegraphs with an impact, add the fixed purple storm sky and lightning grade, and pull the camera out of trunks and canopy (A i11, i13, i15).
Fix faint-state materials and poses: stop the whole-body whitening on Ai faint mid/end and the greyed body on Ru A faint end, and keep Ot B's faint body from collapsing into a legless wool blob.

Re-texture Uv's bird and give Ya/Th's low teal creature more value contrast and a taller silhouette, to match the Galecrest/Stormursa naturalistic bar (blue-grey/tan feathers, real fur/scale break-up, creature clearly taller than the trainer).
